summary.text: Jeremy Amason is a Republican candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 46, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran who works as a consultant, he advanced from the Republican primary on June 23, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Jeremy Amason earned a bachelor's degree from Indiana University in 2019 and served in the U.S. Army from 2019 to 2024; his career experience includes working as a consultant.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Amason described himself as a Baltimore native, a former Army aviation officer and a "Moderate Progressive Republican."

He listed three key campaign messages: affordable living through lower taxes and a lower cost of living, replacing the three-member District 46 with three single-member districts, and improving school performance.
Amason said the first bill he would introduce would create single-delegate districts in all Maryland state legislative districts.
